description: Hawaii Observed Hydropower Generation is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Daniel Broman, Jeremy Giovando (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL), Richland, WA (United States)). This dataset contains compiled observed hydropower generation for hydropower plants in Hawaii. Data have been compiled from data provided to the Energy Information Administration by asset owners. This dataset provides available generation data in monthly and annual files, with quality flags. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
